name: right-trade
description: Right Trade — mobile-first trading automation platform (MVP monorepo)

scripts.dev:api: npm run build:shared && npm run dev -w apps/api
scripts.build:api: npm run build:shared && npm run build -w apps/api
scripts.test:api: npm run build:shared && npm run test -w apps/api
scripts.seed:api: npm run build:shared && npm run seed -w apps/api
scripts.start:mobile: npm run build:shared && npm run start -w apps/mobile
scripts.start:web: npm run build:shared && npm run web -w apps/mobile
scripts.build:web: npm run build:shared && npm run build:web -w apps/mobile
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w packages/shared && npm run build:shared && npm run typecheck -w apps/api && npm run typecheck -w apps/mobile
scripts.build:release: npm run build:shared && npm run build -w apps/api && npm run build:web -w apps/mobile
